label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value at fetchHttpByHostname(host) is attacker-controlled: host = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') which flows directly to URL construction without complete validation. The isNonPublicAddress check only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses, but allows private ranges (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x) and external domains that resolve to internal IPs. Attacker can pass arbitrary hostnames/IPs to reach internal resources. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input param assigned directly to host variable
DNS resolution check only blocks limited address types, not private ranges
SSRF sink: URL constructed with unvalidated host parameter
